transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, I'm Neil. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. I'm flying to New York tomorrow, and last time I came home to a three-hundred-pound bill for data. I'm really anxious it'll happen again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Ignatius. Is your phone on a contract or pay as you go?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And how long are you away?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Will you use data much, maps, video calls?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Maps and some video calls to my kids.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The US travel bolt-on gives you ten gigs for ten pounds a week. I'll add two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does that include calls home too?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a stupid question, obviously it's included.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There's no need to talk to me like that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Anyway, it's added. Can you see it in the app?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it shows US travel, two weeks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good, so you're covered. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
